research_notes: A useful later metric is residual budget abandoned at handoff, because it quantifies conservatism directly.
P1 may abandon more residual budget than P2/P3 when task sizes vary.
P3 may recover more budget if estimates are accurate, but estimation errors can increase overshoot risk.
The final comparison should measure both effects rather than assuming adaptive admission is superior.
The current boundary phase provides the hard budget against which residuals will be measured.
